battle.name: 第二次西西里奴隸起義
battle.theater: 西西里西部莫爾甘提納與特里奧卡拉
battle.brief: 公元前104年，西西里奴工因法務官內爾瓦釋放又收回八百名奴隸而激成起事，前奴隸薩爾維烏斯取名「特律豐」、據山城特里奧卡拉建王號，義軍盛時約四萬，至前101年被執政官阿基利烏斯平定。卡面秦連弩為東亞連發弩機，從未進入地中海，此處借它標示守城者以持續射擊把攻城者釘在牆外的邏輯。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 這場戰爭的雙方是羅馬共和國與西西里島上的被奴役者，交戰主體是行省內部的武裝叛亂，而不是國家之間的戰爭。起義方以西西里中部與東部的奴工為主，包括莊園、礦場與作坊中的勞動者，族屬以希臘人、迦太基人與敘利亞人為多，多數是前241年羅馬兼併西西里之後經市場轉售到島上的戰俘與罪犯；島上奴工因此在行省之中佔到最高比例，成為希臘化城市公民與拉丁殖民地之外最龐大的一群人。羅馬方面是共和國國家機器：元老院先後派遣總督級與執政官級的部隊，另有西西里五座拉丁同盟城市提供基地、兵員與補給；島上自由的拉丁裔公民與希臘化城市的公民地主站在羅馬一方，因為他們的產業與人身安全直接依賴奴役制度得以維持。整場衝突沒有第三國介入，沒有外邦援助，也沒有形成任何跨海聯盟；它自始至終是行省內部的叛亂與鎮壓，是羅馬三次奴隸戰爭中規模與組織程度居中的一次，前後呼應西西里島上一個半世紀累積的莊園奴工問題。
countriesEn: The two sides in this war were the Roman Republic on one hand and the enslaved population of Sicily on the other, and the contest was in essence a large armed rebellion inside a province rather than a war between states. The insurgents were principally the slaves of central and eastern Sicily, including the labourers on estates, in the mines and in the workshops, of predominantly Greek, Carthaginian and Syrian origin, most of them prisoners of war and convicts resold onto the island through the markets after Rome took over Sicily in 241 BC; the servile population therefore came to hold the highest proportion of any province, and constituted by far the largest single group on the island outside the citizen communities of the Hellenic cities and the Latin colonies. On the Roman side stood the apparatus of the Republic: the senate sent first a provincial command and then a consular force, while the five Latin communities of the island supplied bases, men and provisions; the free Latin citizens and the citizen landowners of the Hellenic cities sided with Rome, because their property and their personal security depended directly on the maintenance of the system of slavery. No third country intervened at any point, there was no foreign assistance, and no alliance was formed across the sea. From beginning to end this was a rebellion and its suppression within a province, and of the three slave wars of the Roman Republic it was the one of middling scale and organisation, answering a question of estate slavery on the island that had been accumulating for a century and a half.
people: 起義方留下兩個名字。薩爾維烏斯原本是西西里的奴隸，公元前104年法務官普布利烏斯·利基尼烏斯·內爾瓦依元老院法令釋放約八百名奴隸，隨後又在莊園主施壓下收回成命，激起反抗；內爾瓦派出的六百人部隊在海拉 克萊亞一帶被義軍全殲，薩爾維烏斯趁勢聚眾兩萬餘人，奪取莫爾甘提納。他仿效前一次起義中自號安條克世系的埃努斯，取塞琉古君主狄奧多托斯·特律豐之名，自稱特律豐，在三面環水的山城特里奧卡拉築牆設壘，設宮室、置議會、備侍從，演出君主威儀。奇里乞亞裔的阿特尼翁在島西另起一軍，聞莫爾甘提納之勝即率眾來會，屯兵斯奇爾泰亞；會戰中他的騎兵衝擊羅馬兩翼得利，自己卻墜馬受傷、裝死倖存，部眾誤以為主將已死而潰散，羅馬得以反敗為勝。羅馬方面，先後主事者有鎮壓過坎帕尼亞維提亞奴隸暴動的前任執政官盧基利烏斯·盧庫路斯，他因被撤換而惱怒，故意焚毀攻城器材、遣散部隊，令繼任者更形棘手；繼任者為蓋烏斯·塞爾維利烏斯，前102年在特里奧卡拉一帶被阿特尼翁奇襲營寨而大潰；前101年執政官馬尼烏斯·阿基利烏斯奉命接手，得執政官蓋烏斯·馬略自高盧撥給的數個大隊，甫至即破敵，阿特尼翁據說自刎而死。
peopleEn: Two names survive on the insurgent side. Salvius was a slave in Sicily, and when the propraetor Publius Licinius Nerva manumitted some eight hundred slaves in 104 BC on the senate's order and then revoked the act under pressure from the great proprietors, the population rose in revolt; a detachment of six hundred men sent by Nerva was annihilated by the insurgents near Heraclea, and Salvius gathered more than twenty thousand, taking Morgantina. Following the precedent of Eunus, who in the previous rising proclaimed himself a scion of the Seleucid Antiochus, he took the name of Diodotus Tryphon, a Seleucid ruler, and called himself Tryphon; at the triple-sided stronghold of Triocala he built a wall and a fort, set up a palace, constituted a council and kept attendants, and performed the externals of kingship. Athenion, a Cilician by origin, raised a separate force in the west of the island and marched to join Salvius on hearing of the victory at Morgantina, taking up position at Scirthaea; in the battle his cavalry struck the flanks of the Roman line successfully, but he himself was unhorsed and wounded and saved himself by feigning death, and his men, believing their commander killed, broke and fled, allowing the Romans to reverse the day. On the Roman side the commanders succeeded one another: Lucius Licinius Lucullus, the former praetor who had suppressed the Vettian revolt in Campania, who in resentment at his own replacement burned his siege works and dispersed his troops to make his successor's task harder; then Gaius Servilius, whose camp at Triocala was surprised and smashed by Athenion in 102 BC; and finally the consul Manius Aquillius, who in 101 BC received the command, was given several cohorts by the consul Gaius Marius out of his army in Gaul, defeated the rebels as soon as he arrived, and left Athenion, by common account, to kill himself with his own hand.
kits: 卡面兵器是秦連弩：弩機把弦的拉力儲存起來，踩下踏桿即完成一次上弦與發射，機匣之內可預置數十支矢，一發一發連射。嚴格說，連發弩機的成熟形制在中國是較晚的產物，秦時通行的是蓄力強弩；卡面所呈現的，是把蓄力機構與扳動機括合為一體的連射概念。它並沒有出現在公元前104年的西西里——地中海沒有秦弩，也沒有任何一支中國軍隊踏上過西西里島——但它精確標示出這場攻防中的一個關鍵技術問題：如何讓投射火力在沒有持續補充兵員的情況下連續壓住城牆外或山道上的敵人。功能上最接近的是羅馬的凱羅弩炮（cheiroballista）與固定式大型弩炮（ballista），同樣是預儲扭力、逐矢擊發；而起義軍在特里奧卡拉山寨裡靠投石手、擲石、弓矢與火油從高處傾瀉，性質上正是這種以壓制換取時間的守城邏輯，只是器材臨時湊成。義軍裝備以莊園器具為主：鋤、斧、耙、削尖木矛、漁叉、獵弓，加上從莊園武庫與海拉 克萊亞繳獲的羅馬式短劍、標槍與盾牌——那批羅馬制式兵器正是義軍裝備的骨幹。羅馬方面則是全套制式裝備，長劍、標槍、大盾、頭盔、鎖子甲、攻城塔、撞槌，以及由牛馬拖曳的攻城器械與隨軍工匠。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Qin repeating crossbow: the trigger box stores the pull of the string, and stepping on the treadle completes one nocking-and-loosing cycle, with a magazine in the case holding several tens of bolts so that the shot follows shot. Strictly speaking, the mature form of the repeating crossbow is a later Chinese product, and what the Qin period knew was the powerful tensioned crossbow; what the card shows is the concept of combining the power-storage device with a repeating release. It was of course absent from Sicily in 104 BC: the Mediterranean had no Qin crossbow and no Chinese army ever set foot on the island. Yet it marks exactly the technical problem of this particular siege: how to keep a volume of missile fire on an enemy outside the wall, or on a mountain road, without continuously manning the machine with fresh crews. The closest functional counterparts are the Roman cheiroballista and the large fixed ballista, both of which store torsion in advance and discharge bolt by bolt; the insurgents at the stronghold of Triocala, having no artillery at all, relied on slingers, stones, bows and fire-pots poured down from the heights. The logic was the same, that of buying time with suppression, but the equipment was improvised. The rebel armoury was drawn from farm implements: hoes, axes, rakes, sharpened wooden spears, fish-tridents and hunting bows, together with Roman-style short swords, javelins and shields taken from the estate strongrooms and from the Roman equipment captured at Heraclea, and that captured Roman kit formed the backbone of the rebel armament. The Romans, for their part, brought the full regulation set, long swords, javelins, the large shield, helmets, mail, siege towers, battering rams, and the ox-drawn siege engines with their attendant engineers.
tactics: 起義的爆發靠的是同時性與奇襲。內爾瓦在島上釋放又收回約八百名奴隸的消息傳開，奴工在莊園、礦場與鹽田同時起事：殺死監工、打開武器庫、奪下莊園裡的農具與糧食，再退入中部山區的據點。義軍起初並未立即攻城，而是以游擊與襲擾為主：特律豐在莫爾甘提納集結兩萬餘人，奪城之後乘勢席捲周邊，島西阿特尼翁另一軍與之會合，義軍由游擊隊變成有旗號、有騎兵、有攻城能力的軍隊，總兵力在會戰前約四萬。羅馬最初的教訓是低估對手：六百人分隊在內陸遭殲，害得元老院不得不升級用兵，盧庫路斯遂率一萬七千人的羅馬與盟邦混編大軍自西西里登陸，直指特里奧卡拉。會戰於斯奇爾泰亞進行，義軍在距羅馬營盤十二里的地方列陣，兩軍先以散兵與騎兵互相試探，再主力合攏；義軍一度靠阿特尼翁的騎兵令羅馬兩翼吃緊，卻因主將墜馬的消息傳開而全軍心散，約兩萬人當夜斃於陣前，義軍主力折損一半。圍城階段，羅馬放棄急攻，改採圍城與工事：修築包圍牆切斷要塞對外通道，設置投射兵器陣地，以弩炮與投石機壓制牆頭守軍，夜間以突擊消耗守軍。盧庫路斯被撤換時索性焚毀自己的攻城器械、營帳與糧秣、遣散部隊，把難局留給繼任者；前102年阿特尼翁奇襲塞爾維利烏斯的營寨得手，羅馬軍潰散，前功盡棄。最終的取勝不靠圍城而靠野戰：前101年阿基利烏斯率高盧撥來的大隊與沿途新募、邊行邊訓的部隊，甫一接觸便把義軍戰力打散，餘部在山中逐一清剿，約一千名投降者被押往羅馬鬥獸場充作角鬥士。
tacticsEn: The outbreak of the rising rested on simultaneity and surprise. The news that Nerva had manumitted and then revoked the freedom of some eight hundred slaves spread across the island, and the slaves rose together on the estates, in the mines and in the salt pans: the overseers were killed, the armouries opened, the tools and stores of food seized from the farmhouses, and the insurgents then withdrew into the strong points of the central hills. At first they did not press sieges at all but lived by harassment: Tryphon mustered more than twenty thousand at Morgantina, and after taking the town carried his influence across the surrounding country, while Athenion's separate force in the west of the island closed with him, and the insurgent bands became an army with banners, with cavalry and with the capacity to take towns, numbering some forty thousand before the pitched battle. Rome's first lesson was to underestimate the enemy: a detachment of six hundred was destroyed inland, and the home front was forced to escalate, so that Lucullus landed in western Sicily at the head of seventeen thousand Roman and allied troops and marched straight for Triocala. The battle was fought at Scirthaea, where the rebels drew up twelve miles from the Roman camp; the two sides first probed each other with skirmishers and cavalry and then closed in the main body. The rebels at one point made the Roman flanks give way through Athenion's cavalry, but the news that their commander had fallen unhorsed spread through the ranks and the army lost heart, and about twenty thousand men were cut down before nightfall, half the rebel strength. In the siege phase Rome abandoned the assault in favour of blockade and engineering: a circumvallation was built to cut the fortress off, positions for missile artillery were established, bolt-throwers and stone-throwers kept the parapet under fire, and night attacks wore the garrison down. When Lucullus was replaced he burned his siege engines, his camp and his provisions, dispersed his troops and left his successor the worst of the problem; in 102 BC Athenion surprised and smashed the camp of Gaius Servilius, scattering the Roman army and undoing all that had been won. The final victory came in the open field rather than in a siege: in 101 BC Aquillius, with the cohorts Marius had sent down from Gaul and with troops recruited, equipped and drilled on the march, broke the rebel fighting power on first contact, the remnants were hunted out of the mountains band by band, and about a thousand who surrendered were taken to Rome for the arena.
data: 這場戰爭的年表清楚而數字出自狄奧多羅斯《歷史文庫》第三十六卷，比較可靠。起義自公元前104年爆發，戰事延續到公元前100年，一般記前101年平定。內爾瓦在西西里依令釋放又收回的奴隸約八百人；他派往海拉 克萊亞的部隊為六百人，全軍覆沒。特律豐在莫爾甘提納集結起義軍，兵力約二萬；與阿特尼翁合流後，在斯奇爾泰亞會戰前，狄奧多羅斯估義軍總數約四萬。羅馬方面的最大投入是盧庫路斯率領的一萬七千名羅馬與盟邦混編部隊。斯奇爾泰亞距羅馬營盤約十二里，折合今約十八公里。會戰後，狄奧多羅斯估當夜陣亡的義軍約二萬人，約佔全軍之半。地理上，莫爾甘提納在今艾多內附近的山脊，離愛奧尼亞海岸約六十公里；特里奧卡拉的遺址按法澤洛的記述在今卡拉塔貝洛塔一帶，其名在古希臘語中意為三樣美物，指沃土、泉水與高踞巖石的險要位置；海拉 克萊亞即今阿格里真圖姆以西約二十五公里的南岸古城。戰後有一千名投降者被押往羅馬鬥獸場。史料亦載有梅薩涅錢幣窖藏，與這段戰亂的錢幣流通直接相關。
dataEn: The chronology of this war is clear and the figures come from the thirty-sixth book of Diodorus Siculus, which is among the more reliable sources. The rising began in 104 BC and the fighting ran on to 100 BC, with the revolt generally reckoned as quelled in 101 BC. The number of slaves Nerva manumitted and then re-enslaved in Sicily on the senate's order was about eight hundred; the detachment he sent to Heraclea numbered six hundred and was annihilated. Tryphon mustered the insurgents at Morgantina to a strength of about twenty thousand, and after the junction with Athenion, Diodorus puts the total rebel force before the battle of Scirthaea at around forty thousand. The largest Roman commitment was the mixed Roman and allied force of seventeen thousand led by Lucullus. Scirthaea lay about twelve miles from the Roman camp, some eighteen kilometres in modern terms. Diodorus estimates that about twenty thousand of the rebels fell before nightfall after the battle, roughly half the rebel army. Geographically, Morgantina stands on a ridge near modern Aidone, some sixty kilometres from the Ionian coast; the remains of Triocala lie, on Fazello's report, in the neighbourhood of modern Caltabellotta, its Greek name meaning three beauties and referring to its fertile soil, its springs and its impregnable position on high rock; Heraclea is the ancient city of the southern coast twenty-five kilometres west of Agrigentum. After the war a thousand of those who surrendered were taken to Rome for the arena. The historical record also preserves the Mesagne hoard, directly connected with the movement of coinage in these years of trouble.
cause: 起義的成因可以分三層看。最下層是羅馬的戰爭機器：前264至前241年的第一次布匿戰爭，羅馬兼併西西里，島上大量城邦人口淪為戰俘；前218至前201年的第二次布匿戰爭再帶來一批俘虜，經市場賣入島上莊園，使島上奴工人口比例達到羅馬任何行省的最高水平。第二層是土地與勞動的集中：西西里的耕地高度兼併成巨型莊園，島上自由民小地主與城市公民地主之間的落差，隨著羅馬把西西里變成行省而加深；莊園主要靠奴工耕作、榨油、採鹽與開礦，農產品與礦產流向羅馬與希臘化城市市場。第三層是直接引爆的行政事件：前104年執政官蓋烏斯·馬略為對抗北方辛布里與條頓人而在高盧募兵，向比提尼亞王尼科米德斯三世求援遭拒，理由是比提尼亞的壯丁多已被羅馬稅吏逼賣為奴；元老院聞之，下令不得再從羅馬盟友境內取奴，其已淪為奴者一律釋放。法務官內爾瓦在西西里照令釋放約八百人，卻又在莊園主反對之下收回成命，一放一收之間，示範了羅馬的裁決可以被島上富豪推翻，等於向全島奴工宣告結構性的壓迫無從申辯，遂使零星的不滿瞬間匯成公開叛亂。
causeEn: The causes of the rising can be read on three levels. The lowest is the Roman war machine: the First Punic War of 264 to 241 BC ended with Rome taking Sicily and the populations of its cities falling into Roman hands as prisoners; the Second Punic War of 218 to 201 BC produced a fresh crop of captives, sold through the markets onto the estates of the island, until the proportion of slave labour on the island was the highest in any Roman province. The second level is the concentration of land and labour: the ploughland of Sicily was merged into enormous estates, and the gulf between free smallholders and the citizen landowners of the cities widened as Rome turned the island into a province; the great proprietors worked their land with slaves, pressing oil, harvesting salt and opening mines, and the produce and the minerals flowed to the markets of Rome and of the Hellenic cities. The third level is the administrative incident that set the spark alight: in 104 BC the consul Gaius Marius, mustering in Gaul against the Cimbri and Teutones, asked King Nicomedes III of Bithynia for support and was refused, on the ground that the able-bodied men of Bithynia had already been sold into slavery by Roman tax-gatherers; the senate thereupon ordered that no more slaves be taken from among the allies of Rome and that those already enslaved should be freed at once. The propraetor Nerva manumitted some eight hundred slaves in Sicily in obedience to that order, and then, under pressure from the great proprietors, revoked the act without fear, so that the issuing and the withdrawing of the same decree demonstrated to the whole island that the judgement of Rome could be overturned by the island's rich men. That was to tell the slaves of the entire island that the structural oppression upon them admitted of no appeal, and scattered resentment was instantly fused into open revolt.
impact: 這場戰爭在西西里留下的痕跡，比它本身的戰役規模更深。其一，奴隸軍第二次證明可以組織成有王號、有議會、有騎兵、有攻城能力的軍隊，並且可以打敗常備羅馬軍團在野戰中的優勢——前102年阿特尼翁奇襲塞爾維利烏斯營寨得手，正是這支部隊在會戰失利後仍然具備的戰力；羅馬此後處理奴隸暴動，一概以執政官級大軍與圍城工程回應，這套辦法在幾年後的第三次奴隸戰爭中再被複製並放大。其二，鎮壓的殘酷成為西西里島上集體記憶的原料：羅馬答應繳械者得自由與土地，實際上以詐術分化、以鐵腕收捕，約一千名投降者被押往羅馬鬥獸場充作角鬥士，途中寧可互相以劍相刺、最後一人自刎，也不肯為羅馬人送命；這種羞辱被記在奴工的世代傳述之中，成為下一次大規模抗爭爆發的催化劑。其三，島上莊園制度在戰後不但沒有被動搖，反而因清剿而更加鞏固，羅馬把西西里維持為羅馬城邦的穀倉、橄欖油與硫磺產地，農業奴役的規模與強度都上升；前132年的十人委員會曾經有限度地清查土地，前104年之後再也沒有同類措施。其四，這場戰爭在羅馬的政治史上留下陰影，維爾列斯在西西里任總督時的貪瀆被控與前104年的起義被同樣的莊園結構所滋養，前者與後者並置，成為共和國晚期貪瀆與地方治理爭議的常被援引的對照。其五，在武器史的層面上，這場戰爭留下清晰的對照：以削尖木矛、鋤斧與繳獲的羅馬短劍標槍為主的義軍裝備，與羅馬的制式標槍、長矛、大盾、短劍、鎧甲、弩炮與投石機在同一座山城下相撞，說明地中海世界的攻城與野戰之別，最終由工兵制度與常備軍的組織能力決定。
impactEn: The traces this war left in Sicily run deeper than the scale of the fighting itself. First, a slave army proved for a second time that it could be organised into a force with a royal name, a council, cavalry and the capacity to take towns, and that it could defeat the advantage of the regular Roman legions in open battle: the storming of Servilius' camp by Athenion in 102 BC was exactly the strength such an army still possessed after a lost battle, and from then on Rome answered slave risings with consular armies and siege engineering, a method copied and enlarged a few years later in the third slave war. Second, the brutality of the suppression became raw material for the collective memory of the island: Rome had promised freedom and land to those who laid down their arms, and then divided them by deception and seized them by the iron hand, and about a thousand who surrendered were taken to Rome for the arena, where on the way they chose to kill each other with their swords rather than give the Romans their sport, the last of them falling on his own blade. That humiliation was preserved in the transmitted recollections of the slave population and became a catalyst for the next outbreak. Third, the estate system on the island was not shaken by the war but strengthened by the clearance that followed, and Sicily remained for Rome the granary, the source of olive oil and of sulphur, with the scale and the intensity of agricultural slavery both rising; the commission of ten which surveyed the land in 132 BC found no sequel after 104 BC. Fourth, the war left a shadow in Roman political history, the prosecution of Verres for his misgovernment of Sicily and the rising of 104 BC being nourished by the same estate structure, and set side by side became a standard comparison in the late Republic's arguments about corruption and provincial government. Fifth, at the level of the history of weapons, the war leaves a sharp contrast: the sharpened wooden spears, hoes and axes, and the captured Roman short swords and javelins of the insurgents, set against the Roman standard javelin, spear, large shield, short sword, armour, bolt-thrower and stone-thrower before the same hill-fort, shows that the difference between field and siege warfare in the Mediterranean world was settled at last by the engineers' system and by the organisation of the standing army.
result: 公元前101年，義軍在阿基利烏斯手下崩解。特律豐在斯奇爾泰亞會戰重創之後已死於亂軍，島西的阿特尼翁繼位為首，前102年一度奇襲塞爾維利烏斯營寨而使羅馬前功盡棄，但終究無法把偶爾的襲擊變成持久的軍政體制；前101年阿基利烏斯率執政官蓋烏斯·馬略自高盧撥給的數個大隊，連同沿途招募、裝備並邊行邊訓的部隊，甫一接觸便把義軍戰力打散，餘部在特里奧卡拉的山嶺間被逐一清剿。約一千名投降者被押往羅馬鬥獸場充作角鬥士，據記載，他們在羅馬寧可互相以劍相刺，最後一人自刎，也不肯與野獸搏鬥。羅馬沒有重演前132年那樣的土地清查與授田，莊園制度原封不動，島上奴工人口的比例幾乎未減，這場以奴工為主體的戰爭在軍事上結束，在社會上卻沒有留下任何可見的改變。對起義者而言，他們沒有得到國家、沒有得到土地、也沒有得到自由的可見實質；對羅馬而言，這次平叛加上第一次起義，共消耗了兩個執政官級的遠征，卻在國內政治上留下一個陰影：每一次靠背信與屠戮換來的鎮壓，都可能成為下一次動亂的號角。二十餘年後，同樣的莊園結構在西西里與意大利本土同時養出斯巴達克斯的第三次奴隸戰爭，規模更大，時間更長。
resultEn: In 101 BC the rebel movement came apart under Aquillius. Tryphon had already been killed in the confusion after the rout at Scirthaea, and Athenion of the west succeeded him as leader, raising the camp of Servilius by surprise in 102 BC and undoing all the Romans had won, but he could never turn an occasional raid into a durable military and political organisation. In 101 BC Aquillius, with the cohorts the consul Gaius Marius had sent down from Gaul and with troops recruited, equipped and drilled on the march, broke the fighting power of the rebels on first contact, and the remnants were hunted out band by band among the heights of Triocala. About a thousand of those who surrendered were taken to Rome for the arena; the account has it that at Rome they chose to kill each other with their swords, the last man falling on his own blade, rather than fight the beasts. Rome did not repeat the land survey and allotment of 132 BC: the estate system was left exactly as it was, and the proportion of slave labour on the island was scarcely reduced, so that a war whose protagonists were slaves ended in the military sphere and left no visible change in the social one. For the insurgents it brought no state, no land and no visible substance of freedom; for Rome this suppression and the one before it between them consumed two consular expeditions, yet left a shadow in domestic politics, in that every repression purchased by treachery and killing could sound the knell of the next rising. A little more than twenty years later the same estate structure, in Sicily and in Italy alike, produced Spartacus and a third slave war larger and longer than either.
